descFull: Demonstration for the Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 model with lazy-loaded LoRA adapters for advanced single- and multi-image editing. Supports 7+ specialized LoRAs including photo-to-anime, multi-angle camera control, pose transfer (Any-Pose), upscaling, style transfer, light migration, and manga tone. Features fast inference (4 steps default).
